finding_count_rule: Exactly the two distinct new HIGH findings reported by D1-A4 are retained; linked A3 residuals are historical aliases and are not recounted.

findings.A4_problem: W01-W12 readiness was overclaimed: every declared outputs/d1_execution/V4/Wxx directory was absent, yet execution_ready was true, and required control/final artifacts had no worker ownership.
findings.scientific_or_execution_risk: Worker outputs could be orphaned or unreconcilable, so a structurally false package could enter execution and compromise provenance and final-gate integrity.
findings.exact_required_change: Create the twelve physical worker directories, extend every readiness record with explicit existence and contract/ownership checks, make false directory or ownership checks force execution_ready=false, and assign every required control/final artifact to an explicit worker or named execution stage.
findings.V5_resolution: Created outputs/d1_execution/V4/W01-W12, rebuilt the V5 readiness matrix with fourteen structural boolean checks plus execution_ready, and assigned all worker and stage-owned control/final artifacts.
findings.verification_rule: Test-Path is true for all twelve directories; every readiness boolean is true; every required output has exactly one owner; execution_ready is true only when all required checks pass; launch_authorization remains false.
findings.residual_risk: Runtime contents do not exist until a future authorized execution; structural readiness is therefore not evidence that science has been executed.

findings.A4_problem: The hard-gate control was incomplete: inherited HG-01-HG-10 rows lacked return_route and HG-11-HG-15 were prose-only, so no single machine-checkable HG-01-HG-15 matrix existed.
findings.scientific_or_execution_risk: Final readiness and revision routing could depend on narrative interpretation, allowing a failed gate or ambiguous re-entry to be bypassed.
findings.exact_required_change: Create JSON and Markdown matrices containing exactly HG-01 through HG-15, with required inputs, required artifacts, machine checks, pass/fail conditions, blocked stage, exact return route and re-entry stage, owner, human-review fields and computed status; add route-consistency QA.
findings.V5_resolution: Created a complete fifteen-row hard-gate matrix and a fifteen-row routing QA artifact, with explicit route IDs linked to the V5 revision-routing matrix.
findings.verification_rule: The set of gate IDs is exactly HG-01..HG-15; every row has all required fields; every return_route resolves to one routing entry with a valid return_stage and reentry_gate; no gate is bypassable; pre-execution statuses are NOT_REACHED.
findings.residual_risk: Gate status remains NOT_REACHED until future execution produces evidence; this remediation validates control structure only.

findings.A4_problem: Some inherited worker and human-review route wording remains generic rather than pointing to an exact stage and artifact.
findings.scientific_or_execution_risk: A future revision could require manual interpretation of a route even though the V5 active route table is exact.
findings.exact_required_change: Use the V5 route IDs and exact stage/artifact/re-entry fields for all active routes.
findings.V5_resolution: Deferred as a nonblocking historical-text cleanup; the V5 active routing matrix and hard-gate routing QA use exact unique route IDs.
findings.verification_rule: No active V5 route has generic return wording; any legacy wording is historical and cannot override V5.
findings.defer_justification: Does not affect structural validity because V5 active routes are exact and route QA passes.
findings.residual_risk: A5 should verify that consumers select V5 route IDs rather than historical prose.

findings.A4_problem: The inherited V4 file retains older V2/V3 operational tables and duplicate status blocks.
findings.scientific_or_execution_risk: A reader could select a historical table if precedence is ignored.
findings.exact_required_change: Mark inherited material historical and make one V5 section and the V5 JSON contracts authoritative.
findings.V5_resolution: Resolved structurally in the V5 standalone header and historical-source boundary; the active V5 section explicitly supersedes inherited instructions.
findings.verification_rule: V5 precedence statement appears before embedded V4 source and active package controls are versioned V5.
findings.residual_risk: The embedded historical source remains long by design for provenance.

findings.A4_problem: The V4 package manifest aggregated future outputs and used a section-reference pseudo-artifact.
findings.scientific_or_execution_risk: Granular execution-time package QA could be weakened if future artifacts are not file-backed.
findings.exact_required_change: Use one manifest row per canonical file or physical directory, and mark future outputs deferred without counting them as missing now.
findings.V5_resolution: Resolved in the V5 manifest with granular file/directory rows and explicit required versus deferred status.
findings.verification_rule: Required missing, ownerless, invalid-path and duplicate counts are zero; deferred outputs have required=false and required_at_execution=true.
findings.residual_risk: Future execution must populate deferred rows before HG-12 can pass.

findings.A4_problem: V4 search field aliases differed from the A4 interface names for database/source and human-review requirement.
findings.scientific_or_execution_risk: A strict consumer could reject or misread a search decision row.
findings.exact_required_change: Normalize the active V5 search schema to one field vocabulary while preserving historical aliases only as source history.
findings.V5_resolution: Deferred as a nonblocking schema cleanup; V5 requires one active evidence-first search schema and no open search is executed here.
findings.verification_rule: A5 must confirm active search rows use one normalized vocabulary before any search opens.
findings.defer_justification: No search is opened in plan remediation, and this does not affect worker-directory or hard-gate structural validity.
findings.residual_risk: A future search consumer must normalize or reject legacy aliases before HG-14.
